Much more accurate reading of real Saudi and Egyptian bank SMS (SAB, SABB, HSBC Egypt, STC Pay, QNB, Al Ahli/SNB, Emirates NBD, urpay, Tabby, Mobily Pay, D360, STC Bank, barq).

- **No more double counting**: Arabic one-time passwords and verification codes, transfers between your own accounts, incoming transfers and salary, credit-card repayments, wallet top-ups, Tabby repayments, statements and loan reminders are no longer counted as spending.
- **Merchants found**: shop names after "لدى:", billers ("مفوتر:"), government agencies ("الجهة:"), transfer recipients ("إلى:"), and HSBC/QNB formats. ATM withdrawals and transfers without a shop name are labelled instead of "Unknown".
- **Cards and accounts found**: Arabic card and account wording ("بطاقة", "المنتهية برقم", "من: ***"), STC Pay "Via: *1234", urpay "Card: 1234:MADA", and HSBC masked account numbers.
- Existing transactions are re-read once on first launch after updating, so your totals are corrected automatically. Corrections, labels and card/account answers are kept.

APK: arm64-v8a, built and signed by GitHub Actions.
